children.content:
# 🔷 Complete TypeScript Mastery & Type Gymnastics Track

Welcome to your full TypeScript learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-toolchain` | **Setup & Toolchain** | Node.js, Bun, pnpm, `tsx`, `package.json` configurations |
| `01-compiler-and-tsconfig` | **Compiler Mastery** | Strict flags: `strictNullChecks`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `verbatimModuleSyntax` |
| `02-primitives-literals-satisfies` | **Primitives & Satisfies** | Literals, `as const` deep freezing, `satisfies` operator vs type annotations |
| `03-top-bottom-special-types` | **Type Hierarchy Matrix** | `unknown` vs `any` vs `never` vs `void`, exhaustive checks with `never` |
| `04-objects-aliases-interfaces` | **Objects & Interfaces** | `type` vs `interface`, declaration merging, index signatures, excess property checks |
| `05-unions-intersections-discriminated` | **Discriminated Unions** | Union `|`, Intersection `&`, Tagged/Discriminated Unions, exhaustive pattern matching |
| `06-type-narrowing-and-guards` | **Type Narrowing** | `typeof`, `instanceof`, `in`, user-defined type predicates (`val is Type`), `asserts` |
| `07-functions-overloading-this` | **Functions & Overloads** | Function call signatures, function overloading, explicit `this` parameter typing |
| `08-arrays-tuples-readonly` | **Arrays & Tuples** | `T[]`, labeled tuples `[id: number, name: string]`, `readonly` slices |
| `09-generics-constraints-const` | **Generics Deep-Dive** | Generic functions/classes, `extends` constraints, `const` type parameters |
| `10-index-types-keyof-typeof` | **Index Types & Keyof** | `keyof`, `typeof`, indexed access types `T[K]` |
| `11-conditional-types-and-infer` | **Conditional Types & Infer** | `T extends U ? X : Y`, pattern matching and type extraction with `infer R` |
| `12-mapped-types-key-remapping` | **Mapped Types** | `[K in keyof T]`, key remapping with `as`, modifier manipulation (`+readonly`, `-opt`) |
| `13-template-literal-types` | **Template Literals** | Template literal types `${Route}/${string}`, `Capitalize`, `Uppercase` |
| `14-utility-types-guide` | **Built-in Utility Types** | `Partial`, `Required`, `Readonly`, `Record`, `Pick`, `Omit`, `ReturnType`, `Awaited` |
| `15-classes-oop-parameter-properties` | **Classes & OOP** | `public`/`private`/`protected`, `#private` fields, parameter properties, abstract classes |
| `16-enums-vs-const-objects` | **Enums vs Const Objects** | Enums vs `as const` object map unions |
| `17-modules-and-type-imports` | **Modules & Type Imports** | ESM/CJS interop, `import type`, `export type`, barrel files |
| `18-ambient-declarations-dts` | **Declaration Files** | `.d.ts` ambient declarations, `declare module`, module augmentation |
| `19-modern-tc39-decorators` | **TC39 Decorators** | Stage 3 class and method decorators |
| `20-runtime-validation-zod` | **Runtime Schema Validation** | Zod integration, parsing, `z.infer<typeof Schema>` |
| `21-frontend-and-fullstack-typing` | **Frontend Typing** | React component props, generic hooks, polymorphic components |
| `22-testing-and-tooling` | **Testing & Quality** | Vitest / Node native test runner with TypeScript |
| `23-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield TypeScript interview questions & type puzzles |

---

## 🛠️ How to Navigate & Run

Run any module using `tsx` or `bun`:
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-toolchain
npx tsx index.ts
```

- `unknown`: Safe top type.

# 04 - Type Aliases vs Interfaces

- **Interfaces**: Support declaration merging, better compiler cache performance for OOP.
- **Type Aliases**: Support unions, primitives, tuples, and mapped types.
